candidates.name: Gray-Sage Stand-Collar Half-Zip Active Base
candidates.decisionReason: Full-source body proof shows a clean stand collar, regular shoulder and straight movement-friendly torso. The longer plain body is acceptable only as a supporting Winter base beneath a short cream technical puffer, never with a dark bottom or dark outer layer.

candidates.name: Bean-Green Half-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: It repeats nearly the same bean-green role as T1 while the more exposed zip and slightly shaped torso make it less clean and less useful for the cream-puffer direction.

candidates.name: Light-Green Athletic Hoodie
candidates.decisionReason: The floating product image provides no body or movement proof, and the high-contrast black cords make the piece look more generic than the clean Zara-led active layer required here.

candidates.name: French-Blue Textured Quarter-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: This product-only image does not prove shoulder, torso or sleeve proportion, and the dark textured blue would return the outfit to a conventional cold-weather default.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Quick-Dry Quarter-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: The close torso, contrast paneling and dated quick-dry styling reproduce the skinny technical top problem instead of a modern clean active silhouette.

candidates.name: Mustard Half-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: Mustard is a welcome color, but the close body and lifestyle rather than movement-focused presentation are too fitted for this Winter workout core and would exaggerate any jogger volume.

candidates.name: Sand-Gray Jogger
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated image lacks on-body proportion proof; the synthetic sheen and visibly stacked ankle fabric risk a cheap puddled shape.

candidates.name: Khaki Clean Jogger
candidates.decisionReason: The full worn image is much tighter than the product label suggests: it clings from thigh through calf and creates the skinny technical-pant silhouette the rebuild is removing.

candidates.name: Paris-Gray Utility Jogger
candidates.decisionReason: Although the light gray is useful, the fuller utility volume, cargo-like zip seams and elastic cuffs create a baggier bottom than this clean active core can support.

candidates.name: Khaki Tapered Jogger
candidates.decisionReason: The beach-oriented styling, exposed black drawstring and short gathered cuff read casual-lounge rather than a polished Winter training outfit.
